providers.name: Olist
providers.description: Olist is a Brazilian commerce technology company headquartered in Curitiba, Paraná, offering an integrated ecosystem of solutions that automate business management for online sellers. Its products include an ERP for inventory, invoicing and order automation, a multi-marketplace Integration Hub (Mercado Livre, TikTok Shop and others), a POS for physical stores, a digital account with Pix payments, shipping and fulfillment (Envios), and storefront creation. Olist exposes robust partner APIs through its Technology Partner program ("Parceiro Tecnológico"), where approved developers receive test credentials and Swagger documentation to build and homologate integrations reaching 60,000+ merchants. The public API surface is gated behind partner registration; no open developer portal or OpenAPI specification is published.

providers.name: Carreira Beauty
providers.description: Carreira Beauty (carreirabeauty.com) is a Brazilian online job marketplace connecting beauty, aesthetics, and wellness professionals with employment and freelance opportunities. The platform operates as a two-sided network that lets professionals — manicurists, hairdressers, estheticians, makeup artists, barbers, masotherapists, eyebrow designers, and salon receptionists — create a free professional profile and discover nearby openings, while salons, aesthetic clinics, spas, and studios post jobs and freelance ("freelas") shifts. It offers geographic filtering to match professionals with local roles, direct employer-to-professional communication over WhatsApp, and one free job posting per business with no credit card required. It is a portfolio company of 500 Global. Carreira Beauty is a consumer web application and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Loft
providers.description: Loft is a Brazilian real estate technology (proptech) company founded in 2018 and headquartered in Sao Paulo. It operates a marketplace for buying, selling, and renting residential property alongside a broad platform of software and financial services for the real estate sector, including a CRM and property-management tools for agencies, digital proposals and e-signatures, lead generation, rental administration, and fintech products such as rental guarantees (Fianca Aluguel), home financing, credit with property collateral, and residential and commercial insurance. Backed by a16z, QED Investors, Fifth Wall, D1 Capital, Thrive Capital, and Baillie Gifford, Loft is a market leader in Brazil's real estate fintech space. Loft does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definitions, or client SDKs; its GitHub organization (loft-br) hosts internal engineering and data-science tooling.

providers.name: Enjoei
providers.description: Enjoei is a Brazilian online marketplace (brechó) for buying and selling new and pre-owned fashion, shoes, accessories, electronics, furniture, home goods, and collectibles. Founded in 2009 and headquartered in Sao Paulo, it operates a peer-to-peer resale platform and mobile app ("enjuapp") that connects individual sellers and buyers, handling listings, payments, shipping, and buyer/seller protection. Enjoei is publicly traded on Brazil's B3 exchange (ticker ENJU3). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners. No public developer API, MCP server, or SDKs were found during enrichment; this profile carries the consumer-facing identity and a domain-security probe.

providers.name: Azos
providers.description: Azos is a Brazilian insurtech (founded 2021) that sells fully digital life insurance directly to consumers and through a broker (corretor) channel. Its products include life insurance, serious-illness coverage, accidental-disability coverage, and funeral assistance, all contracted online in minutes with no medical exam, transparent pricing from around R$5/month, and coverage up to R$1 million. The company positions itself as "seguro de vida sem burocracia" (life insurance without bureaucracy) and is backed by Prosus Ventures. Azos runs a consumer app and a broker portal but publishes no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Quinto Andar
providers.description: QuintoAndar is a Brazilian proptech real-estate marketplace that lets people rent and buy homes online without a guarantor, with digital visit scheduling, digital contract signing, rent and sale pricing intelligence (QPreço), owner financial management, and a real-estate consortium financing program. It operates a two-sided marketplace across major Brazilian cities including São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Belo Horizonte, Porto Alegre, Campinas, and Curitiba, earning revenue on rental and sales commissions. Surfaced as a portfolio company of ribbit-capital and enriched into the API Evangelist network. No public developer API surface was found; the company does publish a security.txt with a Bugcrowd bug bounty program.

providers.name: NG.Cash
providers.description: NG.CASH is a Brazilian digital banking platform built for the new generation (roughly ages 12 to 30), founded in 2021 and headquartered in Rio de Janeiro. Authorized by Brazil's Central Bank as a payment institution and electronic currency issuer, it offers a digital account with Pix instant payments, a personalized Mastercard prepaid and virtual card, bill payment, mobile top-ups, a savings feature ("Cofrinho"), allowance management, and a discount marketplace, plus credit products offered as a banking correspondent through partners such as BTG Pactual and QI SCD. NG.CASH is a consumer-facing mobile application (iOS and Android) with over three million active accounts; it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI specification. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and enriched by the API Evangelist network from public sources.

providers.name: Cuponomia
providers.description: Cuponomia is a Brazilian coupons and cashback platform that helps consumers save money on online purchases from more than 2,000 partner retailers. A pioneer in popularizing free discount coupons in Brazil, the company expanded into cashback in 2019 and now operates a website, a browser extension, and mobile apps alongside a Prime membership tier. It is backed by 500 Global. Cuponomia does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI definition; this profile captures its public web presence and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Vixtra
providers.description: Vixtra (VIXTRA Tecnologia e Serviços Financeiros LTDA., CNPJ 43.443.444/0001-04) is a Brazilian trade-finance fintech founded in July 2021 and headquartered in São Paulo, positioning itself as "the Trade Banking of the Brazilian importer." It pioneers financing for importers using in-transit maritime cargo as collateral, and delivers credit, foreign exchange, guarantees, and cash-flow management for foreign trade from a single digital platform. Its products include Crédito Flex (revolving working-capital credit), Crédito Pré (pre-shipment import financing), Câmbio Fácil (100% digital commercial FX), Trade Banking (the unified operations platform), and a Vixtra stablecoin for cross-border payments. Vixtra operates as a banking correspondent of BMP Money Plus SCD and an FX correspondent of Ebury Banco de Câmbio, has raised roughly US$36M (US$30M debt + US$6M seed extension) led by QED Investors with Valor Capital Group, Endeavor Promessas, NXTP Ventures, Actyus, and BluStone, and processes data in compliance with Brazil's LGPD. No public developer portal or API is currently published; the api.vixtra.com host backs the customer application and returns 403 to anonymous callers.

providers.name: Velotax
providers.description: Velotax is a Brazilian digital-credit fintech (mobile app plus velotax.com.br), operating 100% online, that offers unsecured personal loans and income-tax (IRPF) refund advances, disbursed via Pix within 30 minutes of approval — approving even "negativado" (poor-credit) customers because the anticipated tax refund secures repayment. Founded in 2020 by ex-J.P. Morgan bankers Eduardo Esmanhotto and Victor Savioli, it operates as a banking correspondent in partnership with VIA CAPITAL (a Brazilian Central Bank SCD), holds Reclame Aqui's top RA1000 reputation seal, has 3M+ app downloads, and raised a R$125M Series A in 2025 from QED Investors, Valor Capital and Picus Capital. Velotax is a consumer product and publishes no public developer API or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Quero Educação
providers.description: Quero Educação is a Brazilian education-technology company that operates a marketplace connecting students with higher-education institutions across Brazil. Its flagship product Quero Bolsa lets students compare colleges, courses and schools with price transparency and enroll online at discounted tuition, while a suite of institution-facing products — Nota Quero (online entrance exams), Matrícula Digital (digital enrollment), Quero Pago (tuition payments) and Quero Analytics (data intelligence) — helps partner schools fill seats and manage admissions. The company is a 500 Global portfolio company. It maintains a private GitHub organization and a public engineering blog on Medium, but exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or published API documentation at this time; this profile captures its public identity, domain-security posture, and commercial/legal surfaces.

providers.name: TIM
providers.description: TIM S.p.A. (formerly Telecom Italia) is the incumbent Italian telecommunications operator headquartered in Rome and one of the largest telcos in Europe. The group operates fixed and mobile networks across Italy under the TIM Consumer and TIM Enterprise brands, runs TIM Brasil (the second-largest mobile operator in Brazil), and owns a portfolio of technology subsidiaries including Sparkle (international connectivity and quantum-safe infrastructure), Noovle (cloud), Telsy (cybersecurity), and Olivetti (IT services). TIM exposes its mobile network as a programmable platform through the developer.tim.it portal in Italy and through TIM Open Gateway in Brazil, both implementing CAMARA-standard network APIs (SIM Swap, Number Verification, Know Your Customer, IP-to-MSISDN, IP-to- Number, Device Location) jointly defined by the Linux Foundation, TM Forum, and GSMA. These APIs let banks, fintechs, insurers, retailers, and online services authenticate users, detect SIM-swap fraud, verify customer identity, and locate devices using TIM's mobile network as the trust anchor. As of late 2025 TIM Brasil reported 50 million Open Gateway API queries across its catalog.

providers.name: AutoTrac
providers.description: AutoTrac is a Brazilian fleet management and vehicle tracking technology company with over 30 years of experience. As the national market leader, AutoTrac provides satellite and cellular fleet tracking solutions, real-time telemetry, driver journey management, and management intelligence platforms for logistics, agriculture, maritime, and insurance sectors. The company operates its own terrestrial satellite communication station and data center for nationwide coverage.

providers.name: QueroQuitar
providers.description: QueroQuitar is a Brazilian fintech platform that helps consumers and businesses renegotiate and settle overdue debts online. Through its web and mobile apps it connects users with 50+ creditors (including Santander, Claro, Sky, BV, Inter and Carrefour) to arrange discounted, installment-based payoffs, and participates in Brazil's Desenrola Brasil program. It also offers QueroCredito credit products and QueroSaude health services. It is a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass QueroQuitar exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Solfacil
providers.description: Solfacil is a Brazilian clean-energy fintech and photovoltaic distributor that operates the largest solar-energy ecosystem in Latin America. Through a B2B2C model it connects more than 20,000 partner solar integrators to 100% digital solar financing (approval in ~30 seconds, terms up to 120 months), distribution of homologated PV equipment (own branches in Jundiai-SP, Jaboatao dos Guararapes-PE and Tubarao-SC), the Solfacil Smart monitoring and asset-management platform, battery/BESS storage, insurance products, and the Solfacil Academy training programs. Financial products are regulated by the Banco Central do Brasil via Solfacil SCFI S.A. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Fifth Wall and QED Investors; no public developer API was found - the customer surface is the partner Integrator Portal, storefront, and monitoring platform.

providers.name: Cargo X
providers.description: Cargo X (CargoX) is a Sao Paulo based Brazilian logistics technology and fintech company, founded in 2013, that operates one of Brazil's largest digital freight marketplaces - matching shippers (embarcadores) with carriers (transportadoras) and independent truck drivers. Beyond freight brokerage the platform provides dedicated freight desk operations, driver qualification and real-time cargo monitoring, automated issuance of Brazilian transport tax documents (CT-e and MDF-e), cargo insurance, receivables financing and working-capital credit for carriers, and green-freight / ESG programs that reduce empty return trips. The company reached unicorn status with a USD 200M Series F in October 2021 co-led by Tencent and SoftBank, with Valor Capital Group, Lightrock and Oikos participating.

providers.name: Warren
providers.description: Warren (Warren Investimentos e Gestao Patrimonial) is a Brazilian digital wealth-management and investment platform founded in 2017 and based in Porto Alegre. Regulated by Brazil's Central Bank, the CVM securities commission, and ANBIMA, Warren offers a goals-based, fee-only model spanning managed portfolios, ETFs, fixed income, global stocks, gold and crypto, private pension plans, life insurance, currency exchange, and business (PJ) accounts, plus a Warren for Business platform for investment professionals. It is backed by QED Investors, Ribbit Capital, and Citi Ventures. As of this enrichment pass Warren exposes no public developer API, documentation portal, or first-party SDK; its GitHub organization (warrenbrasil) contains internal engineering tooling and courseware rather than a consumer-facing API surface.

providers.name: Amparo
providers.description: Amparo is a Brazilian fintech that supports bereaved families in the days after a funeral. Its Central de Cadastros uses automated document reading and data extraction to register a family once and share that data across partner systems, while a WhatsApp assistant delivers personalized financial guidance covering INSS pension advances, life-insurance payouts, credit, repatriation reimbursements, and debt and inventory organization. Amparo exposes integration APIs so its Central de Cadastros can connect with funeral-home and insurer client systems. Backed by QED Investors.

providers.name: Mediacao Online
providers.description: MOL (Mediacao Online) is Brazil's first online dispute resolution (ODR) platform, founded in 2014 in Sao Paulo. It is a 100% digital, automated platform for negotiation, conciliation, and mediation that lets individuals, companies, and institutions resolve conflicts extrajudicially without going to court. The CNJ-compliant platform covers the full flow, from capturing cases in the courts, building agreement policies, sanitizing and enriching data, through to agreement approval and payment. MOL has facilitated tens of thousands of agreements and counts Magazine Luiza, Itau, and Caixa Economica among its clients. It is backed by 500 Global, Wayra, Canary, and Redpoint eventures. MOL exposes no public developer API or documentation surface.

providers.name: Mombak
providers.description: Mombak is a Brazilian nature-based carbon removal company that acquires degraded and deforested land in the Amazon and restores it through large-scale, biodiverse reforestation with native species, generating high-integrity, high-quality carbon removal credits for corporate buyers. Founded by former Nubank executives and backed by investors including Union Square Ventures, the company combines science, technology, forestry, and carbon-market expertise to remove carbon at scale while restoring native ecosystems. Mombak operates as a corporate and carbon-markets business and publishes a public marketing and news presence; it does not currently expose a public developer API, SDK, or API documentation. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Union Square Ventures and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Genial Care
providers.description: Genial Care is a Brazilian healthtech network providing multidisciplinary, evidence-based care for children with autism spectrum disorder (ASD) and atypical development up to roughly eight years of age. Founded in 2020 in Sao Paulo, it operates a network of clinics ("Casas Geniais") across Greater Sao Paulo delivering ABA (applied behavior analysis), speech-language therapy, and occupational therapy, alongside family assessments, in-person and online consultations, educational content, and a professional training academy. Care is coordinated through a proprietary mobile app that supports continuous monitoring and family engagement. The company partners with major Brazilian health plans (operadoras), which account for the majority of its revenue, and is backed by General Catalyst. Genial Care operates as a consumer/clinical care provider and does not publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Inventa
providers.description: Inventa is a Brazilian B2B commerce platform — a "B2B commerce cloud" — that integrates technology, credit, and logistics on a single platform so brands and distributors can scale wholesale sales in Brazil. Its products include a sales platform that syncs catalogs, orders, inventory, and prices across B2B e-commerce sites and marketplaces via ERP integrations; a field-sales mobile app for sellers; automated credit analysis and approval; shared distribution-center logistics (OMS/WMS/TMS) with fulfillment and 72-hour delivery in the São Paulo region; multichannel customer support; and business-intelligence dashboards. Solution packages span Fulfillment, Response, FullService, and a pay-per-use OnDemand model. The company is headquartered in São Paulo. Inventa configures the API and connector integrations for its customers rather than publishing a public developer portal, so it has no public API artifacts as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Dabee
providers.description: Dabee (dabee.com.br) is a Brazilian consumer-technology review and comparison website that helps shoppers make informed purchasing decisions about electronics and gadgets. It publishes hands-on reviews, side-by-side comparisons, and buying guides across notebooks, smartphones, tablets, monitors, smartwatches, gaming consoles, smart TVs, and networking equipment, with 'vale a pena' (is-it-worth-it) verdicts and price tracking pulled from Amazon Brazil. The site monetizes through affiliate commissions. As of this profile it exposes no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal; it was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio lead.

providers.name: SambaAds
providers.description: SambaAds is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead for enrichment. As of this pass the registered website (ycontent.com.br) serves yContent, a Brazilian coupon and discount aggregation platform (part of Rede de Cupons / Ganhe de Volta) that verifies and publishes working promotional codes for major Brazilian e-commerce retailers such as Amazon, Americanas, Kabum and Sephora. The site is a consumer-facing web property; it publishes no developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery surface, so there is no public API surface to catalog at this time. This profile records the honest result of an enrichment pass (domain-security probe plus well-known and security.txt probes) and remains a lead awaiting any future developer program.

providers.name: Send4 Tecnologia
providers.description: Send4 Tecnologia (rebranded as After Sale) is a Brazilian post-purchase platform for e-commerce, automating product exchanges, returns, and reverse logistics. Founded in 2017, it has processed over 6 million reverse-logistics transactions and offers intelligent authorization rules for approvals and blocks, a self-service customer exchange portal, real-time returns dashboards, revenue-retention offers (vouchers and cashback), integrated shipping labels and tracking, automated refunds and store credit, and multi-channel WhatsApp and email support. It advertises a simple, flexible API to connect with any e-commerce platform in minutes, though no public developer documentation is currently published. After Sale is now part of the Confi ecosystem alongside Neotrust and the Confi consumer app.

providers.name: Mevo
providers.description: Mevo is a Brazilian healthtech company whose stated mission is to "descomplicar a saúde" (simplify healthcare) through a digital platform that connects doctors, patients, and pharmacies. Its products include Mevo Receita Digital (electronic/digital medical prescriptions replacing paper scripts), and Mevo Farma / Mevo Dispensação (online medication purchase, dispensing, and partner-pharmacy fulfillment with delivery). Mevo sells to hospitals, health operators, clinics, and telemedicine platforms as a B2B partner. No public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation portal is currently published; this profile tracks the company in the API Evangelist network. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Matrix Partners and Prosus Ventures.

providers.name: Printi
providers.description: Printi is a Brazilian online commercial print marketplace founded in 2012 and based in Barueri / Sao Paulo, offering business cards, flyers, stationery, labels and stickers, packaging, brochures and folders, and promotional items through an online configurator that prices each job dynamically by format, paper, finish, and quantity. Printi is a Cimpress brand - Vistaprint took a minority stake in 2014 and Cimpress acquired a majority stake in 2020 - and sits in the same Cimpress portfolio as Vistaprint. Printi formerly published a public developer portal at developer.printi.com.br ("Printi API", hosted on ReadMe with a Run in Postman button) covering catalog, quoting, and order operations, but that portal is no longer resolvable and appears decommissioned. There is no live, documented, self-serve public API today; programmatic and reseller integration is now partner-gated, channeled through Cimpress's mass-customization / developer platform and Printi's "Comprar com Vendedor" reseller channel. The APIs below are modeled from the historical portal and observable storefront behavior - they are NOT sourced from a currently published public specification (see review.yml, endpointsModeled).

providers.name: Viajanet
providers.description: Viajanet is a Brazilian online travel agency (OTA) operated within the Despegar group, selling flights, hotels, vacation packages, car rentals and travel insurance to consumers in Brazil through www.viajanet.com.br. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Redpoint Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. Viajanet publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; the enrichment pass captured its live security surface (a published security.txt with a Bugcrowd private bug bounty program run by the Despegar application-security team) and its domain-security posture.

providers.name: Já Entendi
providers.description: Já Entendi is a Brazilian corporate-education (EdTech) company based in Curitiba that converts traditional corporate training materials into short, video-based online courses designed for workforces with lower levels of formal education. Its learning platform combines andragogy, heutagogy, storytelling, neurolinguistics, instructional design, and mind mapping to deliver more effective learning, offering both custom-built training solutions for large employee bases with sensitive or confidential content and a catalog of ready-made courses, all with integrated video lessons, assessments, and exercises. The company reports 1.2M+ students, 100+ courses, and 1,600+ videos delivered. Backed by 500 Global. No public developer portal, API, or SDK is published.

providers.name: Advolve.AI
providers.description: Advolve.AI is an AI-driven performance-marketing and customer-acquisition platform for e-commerce brands and marketplaces, offering an end-to-end solution to automate, scale, and optimize paid media and digital advertising, including a patent-pending creative-optimization capability that tunes interactive ad elements (messaging, graphics, colors, fonts). Founded in 2023 and headquartered in Sao Paulo, Brazil, Advolve was backed by Prosus Ventures and Valor Capital and was acquired by iFood (Prosus group) in November 2025 to power iFood Ads across Latin America. Advolve publishes a marketing website only; as of enrichment it exposes no public developer program, API, SDKs, or documentation surface.

providers.name: elo7
providers.description: Elo7 was a Brazilian online marketplace for handmade, customized, and creative products — frequently described as "the Etsy of Brazil." Founded in 2008 and headquartered in Sao Paulo, it connected independent artisans and small makers with buyers across Brazil for party supplies, decor, crafts, and personalized goods. Etsy acquired Elo7 in July 2021 for roughly USD 217 million, then sold it to Brazilian firm Enjoei S.A. in July 2023, after which the marketplace was wound down and stopped accepting new orders. Elo7 published no public developer API or OpenAPI; its GitHub organization holds only small internal frontend (AMD) utility libraries. This profile entered the API Evangelist network as an Insight Partners portfolio lead and is enriched here with the real, honest surface that remains.

providers.name: HotelUrbano
providers.description: HotelUrbano (later rebranded Hurb) was a Brazilian online travel agency founded in January 2011 by Joao Ricardo Mendes and headquartered in Rio de Janeiro, offering hotel bookings, flights, and flexible travel packages across domestic and international destinations. Once one of Brazil's largest OTAs and backed by investors including Insight Partners and Tiger Global, the company collapsed amid consumer-protection complaints: the Brazilian Ministry of Tourism revoked its Cadastur operating license on 14 April 2025 and the company ceased all operations on 25 October 2025. Its consumer domains (hotelurbano.com.br, hurb.com) no longer resolve and it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI. The only surviving public technical surface is its GitHub organization (hurbcom), which hosts engineering coding challenges and open-source utility forks rather than product APIs. This profile is retained as a historical/defunct-company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Marvin
providers.description: Marvin (Marvin Tecnologia Ltda., CNPJ 41.240.161/0001-30) is a São Paulo, Brazil based B2B fintech and tech-native collateral agent that transforms credit-card and duplicata receivables into registered financial guarantees. Born out of Brazilian Central Bank Resolution 264 — which legalized the negotiation of credit-card receivables as financial assets — Marvin operates a "registration-as-a-service" platform that lets retailers, banks and suppliers register, manage and settle receivables-backed collateral, unlocking working capital for merchants. The company is backed by a US$15M Series A led by Canaan Partners (with Canary and Maúa Capital) and works with partners including B3, C6 Bank, Casas Bahia, Electrolux, Pernambucanas and AVLA. Marvin runs a private backend (app.marvin.com.br) for its customers; it does not currently publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDKs. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a Canaan Partners portfolio lead and enriched from public web sources.

providers.name: Ursula
providers.description: Ursula is a Brazil-based AI startup building AI-native characters. Founded by an Emmy-winning team with experience at Pixar, Unity, Blizzard, and Google, it combines LLMs, symbolic AI, and long-term memory to power emotionally aware digital beings that evolve and connect with users across games, apps, and digital worlds. Ursula is a seed-stage Prosus Ventures portfolio company surfaced for the API Evangelist network. It publishes no public developer API program, and at enrichment time its Framer-hosted website at ursula.ai returned HTTP 404 (site unpublished) while the domain retained valid TLS and SPF/DMARC records.

providers.name: BeautyDate
providers.description: BeautyDate (beautydate.com.br) is a Brazilian beauty and wellness marketplace that connects consumers with salons and independent beauty professionals for discovering and booking appointments online. It was surfaced as a 500 Global venture-portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. At the time of this enrichment pass the public website and application endpoints were unreachable (HTTP 530 behind Cloudflare, with api.beautydate.com.br redirecting to a down app.beautydate.com.br origin), so no developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable specification could be captured.

providers.name: Folhamatic
providers.description: Folhamatic (IOB Folhamatic Group) is a Brazilian developer of integrated accounting, payroll, and fiscal/tax software for accounting firms and businesses, founded in 1990 and headquartered in Americana, Sao Paulo. Its product line includes Folhamatic Payroll for personnel management and electronic files, Electronic Point Control for time-clock management, the Folhamatic Accounting system for management reporting, and Folhamatic Written Tax for tax departments. At acquisition it served more than 11,000 companies with 500-plus employees. Folhamatic was acquired by the UK's Sage Group in June 2012 and now operates as part of Sage in Brazil. The company publishes no first-party public developer API, and the historic folhamatic.com.br domain no longer serves a live site.

providers.name: Magnetis
providers.description: Magnetis is a Brazilian digital wealth management and automated investment (robo-advisor) platform, backed by 500 Global, that offered goal-based portfolio recommendations and managed investment accounts to retail investors in Brazil. The company was acquired by BTG Pactual, and the magnetis.com.br domain now redirects to BTG Pactual's investimentos platform; no independent public developer program or API surface is currently published.

providers.name: Rei do Pitaco
providers.description: Rei do Pitaco is a Brazilian online sports betting, daily fantasy sports, and casino platform founded in 2019 and headquartered in Brazil. The service offers competitive sports odds, live in-play betting, daily fantasy sports contests, and casino games aimed at the Brazilian market. As a regulated iGaming operator its consumer web and mobile properties are geo-restricted outside Brazil (the primary domains return HTTP 451 to non-Brazilian visitors), and the company exposes no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface. Rei do Pitaco is backed by Bullpen Capital and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-sourced company profile.

providers.name: Trocafone
providers.description: Trocafone is a Brazilian e-commerce company specializing in refurbished and pre-owned smartphones and consumer electronics sold with warranty. Operating primarily in Brazil on the VTEX commerce platform, it runs a consumer marketplace for certified semi-new iPhones, Samsung, Motorola and other devices, a trade-in program ("Venda seu aparelho") that buys used devices from consumers, and a Reparofone device-repair service. Backed by 500 Global, the company is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: VivaReal
providers.description: VivaReal operates vivareal.com.br, a Brazilian online real estate marketplace and classifieds portal where consumers search, buy, sell, and rent residential and commercial properties across Brazil, connecting property seekers with real estate agents, agencies, and developers. It was originally backed by 500 Global and later became part of Grupo ZAP / OLX Brasil. It was surfaced as a portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; an enrichment pass found no public developer API surface, portal, or specification.

providers.name: Cayena
providers.description: Cayena is a Brazilian B2B technology company operating an e-procurement marketplace and embedded-fintech platform for the food-service industry. It connects restaurants, bars, hotels, and other food-service buyers with food, beverage, and supply distributors, streamlining ordering, catalog discovery, and fulfillment while layering in payments and short-term credit (buy-now-pay-later) so operators can purchase supplies and defer payment. Headquartered in Sao Paulo, Cayena is backed by venture investors including Canaan Partners. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a portfolio company lead; no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal has been confirmed for Cayena at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Lanistar
providers.description: Lanistar was a London-based consumer fintech founded in 2019 by Gurhan Kiziloz, known for a heavily influencer-marketed "polymorphic" Mastercard debit card with an on-card keypad and display that generated single-use PIN and CVV2 codes. Lanistar Limited operated as an EMD agent of Modulr FS Limited under FCA authorisation, with cards issued by AF Payments Limited, and pivoted its consumer launch to Brazil where it offered a mobile account, Pix transfers and in-app crypto buying and selling. The company never operated a developer program: no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI or other machine-readable contract, SDK, or public GitHub repository was ever published. Lanistar Limited (company number 12091938) was placed into compulsory liquidation by a court winding-up order filed 14 April 2025, and its public surface has since gone dark — lanistar.com and lanistar.app no longer resolve to any web host, the lanistar.co.uk domain is listed for sale by a domain broker, and the com.lanistar Google Play listing has been removed. This profile is retained as a historical record; there is no API surface to enrich.
